column2: Condition 8107 and "60 days" (on 482 pages only - 8107 is correct on the 400 page)
column4: The subclass 482 carries condition 8607, not 8107. Since 1 July 2024 a worker who stops working for their sponsor has up to 180 days at a time (365 days in total over the visa) to find a new sponsor, apply for another visa or leave - not 60 days.
